cr_echo.description: Echoed cross-resonance with active cancellation tone (spec 10 §6.3, T05 §8)

cr_echo_bare.description: ecr: steps 1-4 of cr_echo without the single-qubit corrections

cz_adiabatic.description: Slepian flux pulse detuning the higher-frequency qubit toward |11>-|20> (spec 10 §6.4)

siswap_resonant.description: Coupler flux pulse bringing the pair into resonance for T = pi/(4 g_eff) (spec 10 §6.5)
